routes.note: Overland desert crossing on Darama via the Devourer, Kha'zeel northern pass and the Kha'labal desert. Mostly flat desert, few obstacles. Maps run Darashia→Ankrahmun; reverse them for the opposite direction. All surface (z7).

steps.heading: W/SW
steps.text: Leave Darashia heading toward the Kha'zeel northern pass.
Cross the Kha'labal desert flats.
Continue across the desert toward Ankrahmun.
Final leg into Ankrahmun.

_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + annotated images. Tibia 7.4-era vanilla; verify on Rivalia. Above-ground crossing of the Kha'zeel mountain range (underground alt route via Darama Terramite Cave not covered here).
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground; higher z = deeper underground; lower z = higher up a mountain). 'up' = ascend one floor (climb mountain / go up ladder); 'down' = descend one floor.
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. Each step: floor it happens on, cardinal heading, action, hazards, and any floor transition. Images: orange/white line = path, green = passable cave/grass, red bar = bridge, yellow/blue dots = ladders/holes.

routes.from: Ankrahmun (Kha'labal desert, east side of the Kha'zeel range)
routes.to: Port Hope (Tiquanda jungle, west side of the range)

start.note: Ankrahmun town; exact coords not given in text. Head west toward the mountains.

routes.min_level_note: Mid/high level. Desert side: Hyaenas, Nomads, Bandits. Jungle side: Crocodiles, Elephants, Spit Nettles, Tarantulas, Dworcs, Terror Birds, Carniphilas, and possibly LURED HYDRAS. Do not solo underleveled.

steps.heading: W
steps.text: From Ankrahmun head WEST out of town toward the mountains. Follow the white line up the desert edge. Hyaenas roam here.

steps.heading: W then N
steps.text: Climb the first stretch of mountain. Follow the orange path up the grey rock, working your way up the switchback (ascend a level as you climb).

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Keep climbing the narrow mountain path (orange line) up to the top of the range. Each crop is one higher level of the climb.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: At the top, CROSS THE BRIDGE (red span on the map). 1 Nomad and some Bandits guard it — clear or run.

steps.heading: W
steps.text: Past the bridge, follow the white line WEST across the green ledge. No monsters through this stretch.

steps.heading: SW
steps.text: Begin the descent down the west face. Follow the path down through the green cave/ledge sections; no monsters — just keep going down until you reach a ladder.

steps.heading: S
steps.text: Continue down the white/orange line through the lower ledges to the ladder (marked on Route13, red line into it). Take the ladder down to ground level in Tiquanda.

steps.heading: W then SW
steps.text: Now in Tiquanda jungle. Follow the white line WEST toward Port Hope, then hug SOUTH. The line deliberately arcs SOUTH and OUTSIDE the thickest jungle — AVOID the circled danger zones: CARNIPHILIA! (center), HYDRA! (NE), LIZARDS! (SE). The further south you stay, the safer the terrain. Expect Spiders, Poison Spiders, Tarantulas, Centipedes, Wasps, Crocodiles, Spit Nettles, Dworcs, Elephants, Terror Birds, occasional Carniphila, and watch for LURED HYDRAS.

_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from TibiaWiki 'Mainland Trails' text + annotated overland map (Free_account_routes.png). Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. This is a NETWORK overview, not a single point-to-point route: the map shows the whole free-account overland trail spine plus boat links.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground surface). All overland trails are surface (z=7).
_meta.legend: steps[] enumerates the trail segments and travel links visible on the map. heading = cardinal direction of travel along that leg. action walk = on-foot overland trail; board-boat = water crossing (no land path).

start.note: No single start — network overview. Thais is the southern hub, Kazordoon the central hub, Carlin the northern hub.

routes.min_level_note: Text: mid-low levels can travel if they stay on the paths. Off-path hazards escalate (Dragon at Venore lair, Orc Berserker/Leader near Orc Fortress).
advice: Stay ON the paths except Thais–Venore and Kazordoon–Carlin (those two legs are safe enough to leave the road).
Always carry a Rope and a Shovel — needed for holes/ladders and blocked spots.

steps.heading: hub
steps.text: Thais (south) is the main southern hub. Yellow lines = walkable overland trails; red lines = boat-only water routes; cyan = short boat/ferry hops.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: Thais → Greenshore: short trail NW out of Thais up the west coast to Greenshore.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Thais → Kazordoon: trail runs N/NE from Thais up to the central Kazordoon mountain hub. Passes the sand/desert belt.

steps.heading: E then NE
steps.text: Thais → Venore: long trail E then NE toward Venore, skirting the Outlaw Camp. Text marks this as one of the two legs where leaving the road is tolerable.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: Thais → Outlaw Camp / Dark Cathedral: trail branches SE toward the Outlaw Camp and Dark Cathedral in the southern peninsula.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Kazordoon → Carlin: trail N from the Kazordoon hub to Carlin. Second leg text says is safe enough to leave the road.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: Kazordoon → Ab'Dendriel: trail NE from Kazordoon to the elf city Ab'Dendriel.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Carlin → Northport: trail N up to Northport on the north coast.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Ab'Dendriel → Orc Fortress: trail E into orc territory toward the Orc Fortress.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Venore → Amazon Camp: short trail E from Venore to the Amazon Camp.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: Venore → Shadowthorn: trail SE/E from Venore toward Shadowthorn (elf/orc frontier). Venore Dragon Lair is off this leg — Dragon hazard.

steps.heading: SW
steps.text: Thais → Fibula: cyan hop — short boat/ferry crossing SW to Fibula island. No land path.

steps.heading: central
steps.text: Kazordoon (A) ↔ Kazordoon (B): cyan link across the mountain — the two Kazordoon access points are joined by an internal passage/hop, not a straight surface walk.

steps.heading: W
steps.text: Carlin/Ghostlands → Isle of the Kings → Vega → Senja → Folda: RED boat route — the entire NW archipelago (Folda, Senja, Vega, Ghostlands, Isle of the Kings) is reachable only by boat, no overland trail.

_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + 2 annotated multi-panel images. Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. A SECRET underground passage from Thais to Kazordoon via the Mount Sternum caves — gives exp along the way. Image 1 = 9-panel underground maze (each panel: GREEN circle = where you enter/appear, RED circle = the hole/exit to the next panel, white arrow = path between them). Image 2 = 3-panel surface stretch from the cave exit NE to Kazordoon.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground, higher=deeper). down = descend one floor (hole/ladder). green→red circles chain the cave floors.
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. The green→red circle convention drives the underground floor transitions; the two surface segments bookend the cave crawl.

routes.from: Mount Sternum (cave entrance SE of Thais)
routes.to: Kazordoon (surface entrance, via the cave exit)

start.note: Mount Sternum cave entrance near Thais; exact coords not given in source

routes.min_level_note: Creatures en route: Cyclops, Bat, Skeleton, Ghoul, Bonelord, Dwarf, Dwarf Soldier, Dwarf Guard, Rotworm. May also face Crypt Shamblers, Mummies, Ghosts IF lured. Mid-level+; luring risk is real.

steps.text: PANEL 1 (surface): go into Mount Sternum SE of Thais (white double-arrow points down into the cave). Cyclopes are common right at the entrance.
PANEL 2: appear at the GREEN circle, follow the white line down/across the cavern to the RED circle hole, and descend. 'Follow the way from green to red circles.'
PANEL 3: from the GREEN circle work through the branching tunnels (white arrow) to the RED-circle hole and drop down. Maze section — easy to lure extra monsters here.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: PANEL 4: GREEN circle → follow the white arrow NE across the chamber to the RED-circle hole and descend.
PANEL 5: short hop — GREEN to RED circle (white arrow up-left), then down.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: PANEL 6: the long gallery — from the GREEN circle follow the white line EAST across the full width to the RED-circle hole, then descend. Watch for luring aggro in the open span.
PANEL 7: GREEN circle → thread the tunnels toward the grey dwarf-structure area, to the RED-circle transition.
PANEL 8: GREEN circle → white arrow to the RED-circle hole (lower-right) and descend to the final cave floor.
PANEL 9: GREEN circle at the RED-circle spot, then the GREEN DASHED arrow points UP/out — climb out of the cave system to the surface. 'Then follow the map below.'

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: SURFACE PANEL 1: emerge on the surface; white arrows lead NE (across grass/water) toward the next segment.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: SURFACE PANEL 2: follow the white/orange arrow up the rocky pass; a short cave/hole segment (brown) bridges to the final approach.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: SURFACE PANEL 3: green dashed arrow leads NE to the Kazordoon entrance area (red structure) — you arrive at Kazordoon.

routes.route: Northport → Maze of Lost Souls (MoLS) → Demona
routes.from: Cave south of Northport (north of Carlin), Fields of Glory
routes.note: Route into the MoLS (and on to Demona). Follow the blue line exactly — straying inside the MoLS means Dragons, Dragon Lords, Giant Spiders. Shovel required to open the entry hole.

steps.text: At the cave south of Northport, use a SHOVEL to open the hole (coord ~127.0/123.136/7) and enter.
Follow the BLUE LINE until the next hole.

Keep following the blue line to a small forest inside the cave. In the RED spot, behind the trees, a hole contains a SWITCH — turn it RIGHT to open the MoLS entrance (if already right: turn left then right again).
Exit the hole and follow the path to the MoLS entrance. You must cross some ENERGY FIELDS.
Inside the MoLS: follow the map step by step or face Dragons, Dragon Lords, Giant Spiders. On the marked path you meet the normal area creatures (rats … orc leaders). Do NOT leave the path.
First entrance room = Griffin Shield Quest. Continue to the end and through the Gate of Expertise (level 60).

steps.heading: N then E
steps.text: Go NORTH, take the RIGHT passage all the way to the stairs. Right above = Demona.

routes.return: Exit the MoLS via the maze path in Route_Demona__4_.png (shortest), then retrace the cave route. Alternative exit through Demona (Mols-exit_through_demona.jpg) — expect Warlocks and area monsters.

_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from TibiaWiki 'Route:Edron Bog Raider Cave' text + 6-panel annotated maze map (Bograidercave.gif). Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. This is a dungeon-descent route from the Edron surface down into the Bog Raider cave.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground surface, higher=deeper underground). down = descend one floor.
_meta.legend: steps[] follow the 6 map panels of Bograidercave.gif in reading order (top-left → top-right, then bottom-left → bottom-right). Each panel is a successive underground floor of the maze; the red/marked corridor is the path. The last panel is the cave entrance proper.

start.note: Surface hole; text minimap coords 130.22 / 124.43 / z7. Bring a Rope to climb back out.

routes.min_level_note: Bog Raiders hit hard for their tier — mid-level+ recommended; go with sustain (mana/health) for the descent maze.

steps.text: On the Edron surface, use/go DOWN the hole at ~130.22 124.43 (z7). This drops you into the first cave level (top-left panel).

steps.heading: follow corridor
steps.text: Panel 1 (top-left): follow the winding marked corridor through the first underground chamber to the next hole/descent.
Panel 2 (top-middle): take the branching corridor to the descent point that drops to the next level.

steps.heading: spiral
steps.text: Panel 3 (top-right): follow the spiral/coiled passage around to its inner descent.
Panel 4 (bottom-left): a long snaking corridor — walk it end-to-end to the next hole.
Panel 5 (bottom-middle): short oval chamber with the final descent hole in the middle.

steps.heading: follow corridor
steps.text: Panel 6 (bottom-right): the long marked corridor here is the BEGINNING of the Bog Raider Cave proper — the hunting ground. Green markers along it indicate the spawn zone.

return_shortcut.text: No shortcut given — climb back up the same descent chain with a Rope, or use a return teleport/logout if the cave has one. Retrace the panel maze in reverse.

start.note: Femor Hills area, north of Kazordoon

routes.note: Not a single A→B walk — an annotated hunting-ground map. Ground floor (z7) is the main Goblin spawn between Carlin (W), Ab'Dendriel (NE) and Kazordoon (S). Numbered up/down markers link the underground (z8), a 1-up level, and a top level. Rope required; Shovel/Machete on some routes.

landmarks.surface_feature: Bugs area N, walled compound (B = hole, rumoured goblin house w/ ring+amulet)

steps.heading: central
steps.text: Ground floor: main Goblin spawn. A = open hills, B = a hole (goblin house rumour: ring + amulet, guarded), C = descent near the walled compound.
Underground: 'Rotworms everywhere'. Numbered up-markers (3,4,5,8) and down-markers (6,7) connect back up and deeper; Guildhall in the SW corner as a landmark.
1-up level (above ground) — connected by the numbered up-markers.
Top level — the most dangerous, where Hunters and Demon Skeletons appear. Escape routes documented here.

routes.note: This is the EXIT route out of Hellgate (a deep multi-floor dungeon). Image legend: RED cross = where you currently stand (before going up/down), BLUE cross = where you're heading. Requires Rope + 6 Parcels or Levitate + Key 3012.

steps.text: From the entry platform, go UP the ladder.

steps.heading: W
steps.text: Walk LEFT (west) down a long corridor (skeletons only; going N at the first crossing = ghouls + up to 2 demon skeletons). Go DOWN the hole at the end.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Go RIGHT (east) down another long passage (normal skeletons). Then DOWN the hole.

steps.heading: W then loop
steps.text: Go LEFT then around a long corridor to the YELLOW CIRCLE — go UP with a rope. Straying: one hole = 5 elves + 2 elf scouts (+~20 bugs deeper), other hole = spiders + giant spider.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: Go SOUTH-EAST (rotworms). Down the hole, a little S (2 ghouls), UP. Follow S (2 ghouls + 2 rotworms etc), then UP.

steps.heading: S
steps.text: Go S and down the FIRST hole you see. (The second roping spot has Poison Spiders + 1 Ghoul — avoid.)

steps.heading: W
steps.text: Go LEFT through a big room: ~15 Ghouls, ~5 Skeletons, ~2 Bonelords, plus Elder Bonelords (may be lured). ADVICE: hug the SOUTHERN wall to avoid extra mobs. Then DOWN the hole.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: Go NORTH-WEST (NO monsters). Need 6 Parcels or Levitate to climb up 2 floors, then UP the ladder.

steps.heading: SW
steps.text: Go SOUTH-WEST and UP the hole. (Other hole SE descends to the lava levels — avoid.)
You may need to pull a SWITCH here (opens a bridge 1 floor up). Then just keep going UP (only one way) through many Wasps → surface near Ab'Dendriel.

routes.alternative: Exit via Draconia and Red Bone Castle (separate route).

_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + 2 annotated images. Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. Route through the Kazordoon mines to the Steam Boat dock (useful for the Postman Quest). The steamship itself is a boat-link, NOT a walkable tile — reaching it ends the on-foot route.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground, higher=deeper). down = descend one floor (ladder/stairs/hole).
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. The path descends repeatedly through the mines (each dotted-yellow marker = a ladder/hole transition) then boards the steam ship to Cormaya.

routes.from: Kazordoon Entrance (surface, green dot on map 1)
routes.to: Steam ship to Cormaya (boat dock deep in the mines)

start.note: Kazordoon Entrance marked with green dot; exact coords not given in source

routes.min_level_note: Text: face Bats, Rotworms, Dwarves and Dwarf Soldiers through the mines. A less dangerous but longer alternative avoids Dwarf Soldiers.

alternatives.text: A less dangerous but LONGER way exists with NO Dwarf Soldiers.

You can buy an ore-wagon ticket and ride the wagon directly to the steamship from the depot, temple, main entrance, or shops (or indirectly from the magic carpet and the N/S/W surface entrances) — bypassing the on-foot mine descent entirely.

steps.heading: S
steps.text: From the Kazordoon Entrance (green dot, top-left), head down the long corridor and take 'Down the stairs' (dotted marker, bottom of the red entrance box).

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Follow the white line EAST through the tunnel network out of the entrance chamber toward the first ladder cluster.
At the middle marker use the 'Down and up these ladders' spot — a ladder pair that steps you down then back up to route around an obstacle, continuing EAST.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Continue EAST to the right-hand marker 'Down these ladders' (dotted line) and descend. The map notes '(see next map)' — the route continues on Steamship_kazordoon2.gif.
Continued from last map: at top-left take 'Down this ladder', then follow the white line SW.

steps.heading: S
steps.text: At the bottom-left marker 'Go down here' descend again (dotted line runs EAST to the next box).
Middle box: 'Down here again' — one more descent, then the dotted line continues EAST toward the dock chamber.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Right box: follow the white line up into the water chamber and board the 'Steam ship to Cormaya' (the vessel on the blue water). This boat-link is the route's end — you sail, you do not walk onward.

_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + annotated images. Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. This route is a HUB overview (routes around/through/into Kazordoon), not a single A→B corridor — steps cover the entrance descent, the surface city connections, and the Dwarf Mine exit.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground, higher=deeper). down = descend one floor (ladder/hole/rope-spot).
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. Each step: floor, cardinal heading, action, hazards, and floor transition. Kazordoon is inside a mountain, entered from the surface and traversed via mine tunnels.

routes.route: Kazordoon (routes around / through / into the mountain city)
routes.from: Surface north of Dwarven Bridge (Kazordoon mountain, central Tibia)
routes.to: Kazordoon city / Dwarf Mines (and onward connections to Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Thais, Venore)

start.note: Kazordoon entrance on the mountain surface — exact coords not given in source

routes.min_level_note: Text: face Poison Spiders, Spiders, Rotworms, Wolves, Dwarfs, and a Dwarf Soldier on the Dwarf Bridge. Rope + Shovel required.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Approach the Kazordoon entrance on the mountain surface (white line leads up to the marked 'Kazordoon entrance'). Dwarven Bridge lies to the SE.
Enter the entrance and go DOWN into the mountain. Inset (red box) shows the underground passage: descend the marked hole ('Down this hole', dotted yellow line) to move through the tunnel.
Follow the tunnel; at the far end use the 'Rope up' spot (marked A = roping spot) to reach the next connecting level. Beware hidden holes.

CITY CONNECTIONS (surface hub): from the Kazordoon entrance area, white arrows fan out — NW to Carlin, NE to Ab'Dendriel, S to Thais, SE to Venore (via the Dwarf Bridge). Two rope holes and a stairs on the west side link surface levels.
To cross the western gap, take the 'Stairs' down, or use either 'Rope Hole' (two are marked) to shortcut between the upper and lower surface levels.

steps.heading: NW/W
steps.text: DWARF MINE EXIT: from the mines, follow the white arrows NW/W. Use the marked 'Shovel Hole'(s) (dig with shovel) and 'Rope Hole' to change levels; the 'Stairs' (top-right, circled) returns you toward the surface.

HIDDEN-HOLE WARNING: in the mine, A (red circle) = a roping spot you CAN climb back up; B (green/red circle) = a HIDDEN hole you fall through. Do not confuse them — dropping into B is one of the classic Kazordoon traps.

_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + annotated images. Tibia 7.4-era vanilla; verify on Rivalia. The 'Level 1' route bypasses the switch-tile barrier on the northern Rookgaard bridge by going through a hidden underground cave. A ROPE is mandatory — several transitions are rope-up holes, not ladders.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords (format in text is minimap 125.xx 125.yy z, not raw). z = floor (7=ground; higher z = deeper). 'down' = descend (pitfall/ladder). 'rope-up' = ascend via a rope spot (needs a Rope). 'up' = ascend via ladder.
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. Cave maps: yellow circle = current/entry hole or key ladder, green circle = target next hole/ladder. Note the route ZIG-ZAGS up and down floors — it is NOT monotonic descent.

routes.route: Rookgaard town → West Rookgaard wilderness (Level 1 bypass)
routes.from: Rookgaard town (through the barn, NE of the wheat field)
routes.to: Western Rookgaard wilderness (surface), bypassing the north-bridge switch-tile barrier

start.note: Pitfall NE of the wheat field, behind the Rookgaard barn. Text minimap coords ~125.76 125.176 7 (floor 7).

routes.min_level_note: Any level CAN take it (built for level 1s to skip the bridge barrier), but NOT advised solo/underprepared. Poison Spider poison is lethal to low levels. Bring a ROPE (required) + Antidote or several Small Health Potions. Cave holds Rats, Spiders, Bugs, Poison Spiders, Trolls; Wolves/Snakes at the exit.
requirements: Antidote Potion or Small Health Potions (recommended)

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: Go through the Rookgaard barn and step onto the PITFALL north-east of the wheat field to drop into the cave. (Pitfall marked by the X on the gif.)

steps.heading: SW
steps.text: Follow the cave SOUTH-WEST and take the ladder down. A single Spider waits below.

steps.heading: W
steps.text: ROPE UP the hole on the WEST side of the room (needs Rope). Another Spider up here. This rope hole intentionally blocks ropeless newcomers from getting stuck.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: Go down the ladder to the NORTH-WEST. A single Poison Spider spawns here.

steps.heading: SW then N then SE
steps.text: ROPE UP the hole on the SOUTH-WEST end of the room (yellow circle = the rope hole; green circle = where you land / next target). Face a Rat + one or more Spiders and Bugs. Do NOT go south into the spider/bug cave — instead go NORTH and follow the cave around, turning SOUTH-EAST when you can, to a ladder by a warning sign.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: At the ladder by the 'DANGER! Only experienced adventurers should proceed from here.' sign, go DOWN. On landing you see a Dead Human (contains Leather Legs). To the EAST is a Troll and 2 ladders down — take the EASTERN ladder.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Go down the EASTERN ladder (yellow circle) into the troll cave. Green circle marks the next objective.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: In the troll cave go NORTH and down the stairs. This is the HARDEST part of the cave.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: DANGER FLOOR: you may drop in among 3 Poison Spiders; floor holds 3 Spiders + 6 Poison Spiders total. Get to the NORTH-WEST end and go UP the ladder (green circle on Map_4). Poison here is deadly for low levels — use Antidote/heal.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: This floor has a few Trolls. Follow the cave ALL THE WAY NORTH and go UP the ladder.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: Go NORTH-EAST to the next ladder. Face a few Trolls and a Spider, then go UP.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: Go NORTH-WEST. IGNORE the ladder DOWN — instead take the next ladder UP to the surface. (Easy to mis-take the down ladder here.)

steps.heading: S
steps.text: You surface in the WESTERN Rookgaard wilderness (~125.58 125.91 7) among a bunch of Spiders — the barrier is now behind/bypassed. To reach the EAST part, cross the bridge at the top of the mountain to the SOUTH.

_meta.note: POC — walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + annotated images. Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. Format proposal for routes-logic.json (all 22).
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground, higher=deeper). down = descend one floor (ladder/hole/rope-spot).
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. Each step: floor it happens on, cardinal heading, action (walk/descend/cross/fight), any hazards, and the transition to the next floor.

start.note: Ancient Temple entrance, coord approx from text 126.100/125.171

routes.min_level_note: text implies mid-level; Cyclopes + Minotaurs en route

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Enter the Ancient Temple north of Thais.
Go DOWN two levels, then head as far NORTH as you can.
Go down to the Rotworm level.

steps.heading: E then S
steps.text: Follow the corridor EAST then SOUTH to the ladder (blue line A→B on the image). Go down the ladder.
Poison Fields here. Run through + use Antidote, OR use Destroy Field to clear a path.
Go down another level.

steps.heading: E then N
steps.text: Follow the path EAST then NORTH. Descend the CIRCLED hole on the map. Fight 2 Cyclopes at the bottom.
After the Cyclopes just follow the blue line A→B across the maze levels. No monsters here (maybe a Rat).
At the two ladders take either one, then a few steps WEST → you stand at the Mintwallin gate.

return_shortcut.text: Going back: shortcut through a hole with 2 Bonelords. Follow the RED line to it, then exit via the BLUE line. NOTE: one-way — you canNOT re-enter Mintwallin this way. The red-circled hole is 'blind' (you fall through but can't rope up there).

routes.from: Otherworld entrances (Darama / Zao / Svargrond glowing vortexes)

start.note: Otherworld, coords approx; endgame HoD quest area

routes.note: ENDGAME (Heart of Destruction) — far above your level, included for completeness. The Otherworld is a shifting maze: 3 entrances, only ONE open at a time, passages change. A Spying Eye checks which of the 3 Glowing Vortexes is active. If lost: reach the Vortex Hub (safe area, coord ~125.162/122.96/11) and use a Temple Teleport, or backtrack via the hub routes.

steps.text: Enter via whichever Glowing Vortex is currently open (Darama / Zao / Svargrond). Begin at the orange STAR on each map, head to the green arrows (up/down) and red cross.
Route to the Vortex Hub depends on your entrance. The hub is reached after killing one of the 5 charge bosses.
Regardless of the active entrance, you can ALWAYS leave the hub via the path toward the Darama entrance (take the northern red exit vortex first).

routes.hazard_note: Locations become unreachable when walls appear (one per entrance vortex); a yellow dot next to each wall = emergency exit if trapped.

_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from TibiaWiki 'Thaian-Venorean Road' text + map (Thaian-Venorean_Road.png). Tibia 7.4 vanilla (implemented 7.1); verify on Rivalia. Overland surface road connecting Thais and Venore across the mainland.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground surface). Entire road is surface (z=7).
_meta.legend: steps[] follow the white road line on the map W→E from Thais to Venore. heading = cardinal direction of travel; landmarks are the buildings/POI passed along the road.

start.note: Thais NE gate. The road is the classic mainland link between the two cities; also the safer of the two 'leave the road OK' legs per Mainland Trails.

routes.min_level_note: Low-mid level friendly if on the road; the surrounding wilds hold tougher spawns. Venore Dragon Lair sits off the east end.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Leave Thais by the NE gate. The white road heads N/NE out of the city, past the Thais Graveyard and Dark Mansion.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: Follow the road NE, climbing toward the high ground. It crosses a river bridge and rises over Mount Sternum — the road's high point (Mount Sternum Outlook Tower / Triangle Tower area).

steps.heading: peak
steps.text: Over the top of Mount Sternum the road turns and begins descending eastward. Lubo's Adventurer-Shop and Postal Service HQ sit along this stretch.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: Descend SE toward the sand belt — the road skirts the NORTH edge of the Jakundaf Desert (the tan region on the map). Stay on the road; the desert interior is exposed.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Continue E across the plains past Mac Noodles and the Wolftower. Alatar Lake and Riverspring are off to the sides.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: The road runs into the Venore wetlands and arrives at the Venore Horse Station on the SW side of the city. Venore Dragon Lair is nearby to the E — Dragon hazard off-road.

return_shortcut.text: Same road in reverse (Venore → Thais): W over Mount Sternum then S down into Thais. Alternatively take the Venore boat/carpet travel to skip the walk entirely.

missions.title: West Coast Containment
steps: Daniel Steelsoul asked you to defend Edron by eliminating 500 trolls and 500 goblins that are invading from the western coast.
You have lowered the troll and goblin presence along Edron's western coast.
Report to Daniel Steelsoul in Edron for further orders.
Return to him once both tasks are complete.

missions.title: Cyclopolis Offensive
steps: Daniel Steelsoul needs the cyclops forces of Cyclopolis reduced by 500 to keep Edron secure.
You have severely weakened the cyclops of Cyclopolis.
Report to Daniel Steelsoul in Edron to receive your reward.
Await Daniel Steelsoul's next set of orders.
Return to Daniel Steelsoul once the task is complete.

missions.title: Forbidden Ruins
steps: Daniel Steelsoul needs the forgotten ruins to be investigated.
You have investigated forbidden ruins.
Report to Daniel Steelsoul in Edron.
Await Daniel Steelsoul's next set of orders.
Return to Daniel Steelsoul once you investigate the ruins.

missions.title: Brotherhood Cult
steps: Go tell Gundralph, Puffels and Ursula about the cult so we can start a plan to engage in the ruins once more.
Gundralph wants you to outresource the cult by killing 2500 Dragons and 1000 Dragon Lords.
You have already outresourced the cult. Report it back to the Gundralph.
Go to the Puffels and talk to him about the cult.
Master the fight against cultists by killing 400 Warlocks.
You have already mastered the fight against cultists. Report it back to the Puffels.
Go tell Ursula about the cult and take her advice.
Defeat the darkness by killing 400 Demons.
You have already defeated the darkness. Report it to Ursula immediately.
Report the plan to Zoltan.
Get tactical instructions from Daniel Steelsoul.
Investigate Carlin and Queen Eloise to get an evidence.
You have found the needed evidence. Report it to Daniel Steelsoul.
Weaken the Carlin's army by killing 100 Queen Followers.
You have weakened the Carlin's army. Go back to Daniel Steelsoul.
Kill Algatha in the depths of the forbidden ruins north of Edron.
You've defeated Algatha and her cursed cult. Go tell Daniel Steelsoul
You have finished all the missions. You can now buy spell from the Zoltan if you haven't.

missions.title: The Queen's Trade Route
steps: Queen Eloise of Carlin granted you permission to secure her new trade route to the icy continent of Tarafhyr. Speak with Captain Depward at the Carlin harbour and ask him for passage to Nivarya.
Captain Depward's ship crashed on a Sea Tyrant island near Nivarya. Speak with him again on the wreck to learn how you can help.
Captain Depward needs the Sea Tyrant nest weakened before he can finish repairs. Kill 500 Sea Tyrants near the wreck.
You secured the trade route. Captain Depward can now ferry you safely between Carlin and Nivarya. Speak with Inquisitor Rayin in the city to offer your help.

missions.title: Sewer Goblins
steps: Inquisitor Rayin sent you to Satir at the archery shop. He suspects an Ice Goblin nest in the city sewers is behind the recent kidnappings. Ask him for a mission.
Satir wants the Ice Goblin nest in Nivarya's sewers wiped out.
Satir thanked you for cleansing the sewers. Return to Inquisitor Rayin for your next task.

missions.title: The Witches of the Jothuns
steps: Visary at the magic shop fears the Ice Witches are persuading the friendly Jothuns into sacrificing Nivarya. Speak with him.
Visary asked you to wipe out the Ice Witches before they turn the Jothuns against the city.
The Ice Witches have been pushed back. Report your success to Visary at the magic shop.
Visary thanked you for protecting the Jothun alliance. Return to Inquisitor Rayin for your next assignment.

missions.title: Old Brend's Farm
steps: Monk Fryns at the city temple is worried about Old Brend's farm: no food has been delivered in weeks and his wives have vanished. Visit Fryns for the details.
Travel to Old Brend's farm and investigate what happened to him and his wives. Search for clues, then return to Monk Fryns.
Read the letter you found at Brend's farm to uncover the truth, then report back to Monk Fryns.
You discovered the dark practices behind Old Brend. Return to Monk Fryns at the temple.
Monk Fryns is grateful for your investigation. Speak with Inquisitor Rayin to receive your next task.

missions.title: Trade With Carlin
steps: Captain Frosty at the Nivarya harbour needs help establishing a fresh-seafood trade with Queen Eloise of Carlin. Speak with him.
Use a pickaxe to open the ice holes around the city, then fish with a fishing rod and worms. Bring Captain Frosty 10 Rainbow Trout and 10 Green Perch.
You caught the required fish. Deliver them to Captain Frosty at the harbour.
Captain Frosty sent the catch to Queen Eloise. Report back to Inquisitor Rayin for the next mission.

missions.title: Arxcel's Star Herbs
steps: The Inquisition's healer Arxcel works from a cave east of the city. Visit him to learn about the missing healing supplies.
Arxcel needs Star Herbs from the ruin northwest of Nivarya. Find Inquisitor Blade outside the ruin and ask him for permission.
Inquisitor Blade demands proof of your strength.
You earned Inquisitor Blade's respect. Return to him to receive entry to the ruin.
Enter the vampire-infested underground ruin through the mountain cave. On the ground floor to the right, harvest the Star Herbs from the garden.
You collected the Star Herbs. Bring them back to Arxcel in his cave, then speak with Inquisitor Rayin.

missions.title: The Inquisition's Armory
steps: Inquisitor Rayin is preparing the Inquisition's armory for the next sacred cleansing. Speak with him to begin the supply delivery.

You stocked Rayin's armory, claimed the Inquisitor's reward chest (5,000 gold, an inquisitor artifact, and 10,000 exp) and earned access to the Nivarya bastion. Seek out High Inquisitor Fluleon inside the bastion for the next chapter.
Bring Inquisitor Rayin the following equipment, one delivery at a time: - %s Next delivery: %s.

missions.title: Western Expedition
steps: High Inquisitor Fluleon commands the city of Nivarya from the bastion. Speak with him about the curse on the continent of Tarafhyr.
Fluleon dispatched you to the western mountain base. Find High Inquisitor Sereun and offer reinforcements for the holy expedition.
Sereun wants you to test your strength against the undead breaching the underground farm east of the base.
You proved your worth. Sereun cleared you to cross the mountain wall and investigate the cursed lands beyond — the volcanic activity to the northwest and the lost royal library.

missions.title: Essences of the Fallen
steps: Once Sereun lets you cross the mountain, hunt down the two cursed champions to absorb their essences.

Two of Queen Persh's fallen champions must be slain to break the final seal at the Nivarya Cathedral. Each champion is summoned by a server-wide kill quota of regional creatures, then beaten down while you stand within 7 tiles so the essence drips into you.
Reach their hunt zones from the cathedral's side seals (each consumes 1 amulet from its altar):
- Place a scarab amulet on the western altar; the flame teleports you to the Chaos Hydra hunt — Sayron, the loyal spawns after 80 Chaos Hydras are killed (server-wide).
- Place an ancient amulet on the eastern altar; the flame teleports you to the Bonereaper hunt — Fherumin, the wise spawns after 120 Bonereapers are killed (server-wide).
Essences carried: Sayron %d, Fherumin %d.

missions.title: The Sealed Void Draken
steps: Enter the Undead Island through the Undead Mirror passage (requires 500 Frozemoth kills), navigate the five pagoda passage puzzles, then arrange the gems on Queen Persh's gem-switch tiles. Pull the lever and speak with the Sealed Void Draken — Sayron, Queen Persh's loyal protector — to learn the curse's truth.
You spoke with the Sealed Void Draken. Now find Queen Persh's flame to absorb the essence of loyalty.
You absorbed the essence of loyalty. Travel to the Nivarya Cathedral and prepare to face the final seal.

missions.title: The Cathedral Seals
steps: First absorb the essence of loyalty at Queen Persh's flame, then return to the Nivarya Cathedral.

Open the Nivarya Cathedral by placing a white pearl on its outer altar and pulling the entry switch. Inside, cross the final seal flame — it consumes 1 essence of Sayron and 1 essence of Fherumin per crossing.
Essences carried: Sayron %d, Fherumin %d.
Behind the seal, pull the final lever to face Sapiovor — the embodiment of Tafariel's curse. Entry locks server-wide for the day once the boss is summoned.
The great evil has been stopped. Report your victory to High Inquisitor Sereun at the expedition base.

missions.title: The Curse Broken
steps: After defeating Sapiovor, report back to High Inquisitor Sereun at the expedition base to receive your final reward.
You have shattered Tafariel's curse over Tarafhyr. Claim your well-deserved reward in the underground vault of the cathedral at the expedition base.

missions.title: Mark of Accreditation
steps: You have paid the 100,000 gold accreditation fee to King Tibianus. The doors of the Trade Faction are open to you—visit Zarith the Accredited to trade.
Speak with King Tibianus about a trading document and pay the 100,000 gold accreditation fee to gain access to Zarith the Accredited.

missions.title: Greeting the Djinns
steps: Seek out the djinns and learn their traditional greeting to show you come in peace.
You learned the greeting djanni'hah. Decide whether to support the blue-skinned Marid or the green-skinned Efreet.
You pledged loyalty to the Marid. Travel to Ashta'daramai and help Fa'hradin and Gabel end the conflict.
You sided with the Efreet. Report to Ubaid and Baa'leal in Mal'ouquah to advance their war effort.

missions.title: Marid Faction
steps: To aid the Marid, pledge yourself to their cause in Ashta'daramai.
Bo'ques in Ashta'daramai needs a dwarven cookbook. Recover it so Fa'hradin will trust you with further work.
Deliver the dwarven cookbook to Bo'ques so he can complete his recipe collection.
Fa'hradin wants intelligence from Mal'ouquah. Sneak in through the back entrance and steal the spy report without being caught.
Bring the stolen spy report back to Fa'hradin so he can brief Gabel.
Speak with Gabel about Fa'hradin's findings. He will ask you to place Fa'hradin's lamp in Malor's quarters inside Mal'ouquah.
Secure Fa'hradin's lamp from the Orc King and infiltrate Mal'ouquah to hide it in Malor's room.
Return to Gabel in Ashta'daramai after planting the lamp to receive the Marid's gratitude and trading rights.
You completed the Marid's operations against the Efreet and earned their trust.

missions.title: Efreet Faction
steps: To support the Efreet, swear loyalty to King Malor's followers in Mal'ouquah.
Baa'leal wants the thief stealing their supplies found. Search Carlin for clues and confront the culprit.
You discovered the supply thief. Report back to Baa'leal to receive your reward and the next orders.
Baa'leal redirected you to Alesar for a new assignment.
Alesar needs a Tear of Daraman from the Marid. Infiltrate Ashta'daramai and steal the sacred gem.
Bring the stolen Tear of Daraman to Alesar in Mal'ouquah.
Malor is ready to trust you after Alesar's mission. Seek him out for a decisive task.
Malor tasks you with capturing Fa'hradin's lamp. Retrieve it and place it in Malor's chambers to turn the war.
Fa'hradin's lamp must be positioned inside Malor's personal quarters. Complete the infiltration.
Report back to Malor after securing the lamp to earn access to Efreet traders Alesar and Yaman.
You completed the Efreet war effort and earned their confidence.

missions.title: Officer Training
steps: Kevin Postner asked you to inspect the standard travel routes. Sail with Captain Bluebear from Thais to Carlin before reporting back.
You travelled with Captain Bluebear. Next, accompany Uzon from the Femor Hills to Edron.
You already took Uzon's route. Board Captain Seahorse's ship in Venore and travel to the city.
Only Brodrosch's route to Cormaya remains. Meet him in Kazordoon and ride his steamship.
You inspected every route. Report back to Kevin Postner in the post office.

missions.title: Jammed Mailbox
steps: A mailbox on Folda's so-called mountain is jammed. Bring a crowbar, travel there and fix it.
The mailbox is working again. Return to Kevin for your next assignment.

missions.title: The Magic Hat
steps: Track down the stage magician David Brassacres somewhere in Venore and deliver the bill you received.
You revealed David Brassacres' true identity. Hand him the bill and make sure he accepts it.
David Brassacres paid his dues. Report the success to Kevin Postner.

missions.title: Bones for the Guild
steps: Collect twenty bones for the officers' safety fund. Kevin keeps an example bone in his office.
You delivered %d of the twenty bones that Kevin requested. Keep hunting for more.
You secured all bones for the safety fund. Let Kevin know about your accomplishment.
The officers' safety fund is fully stocked.

missions.title: Fibula's Present
steps: Deliver the valuable present from Kevin's office to Dermot on Fibula without opening it.
Dermot received the present. Report back to Kevin Postner.

missions.title: Uniform Logistics
steps: Negotiate with Hugo Chief in Venore about producing new post officer uniforms.
Hugo needs the original dress pattern. Ask Kevin Postner where to retrieve it.
Kevin sent you to the technomancer Talphion in Kazordoon for the dress pattern details.
Bring Talphion's instructions back to Kevin in the post office.
Queen Eloise in Carlin should provide the colour samples for the uniforms. Speak with her.
Report to Kevin so he can prepare the anti-dog measures for the uniforms.
Perform the sniff test with King Tibianus' dog Noodles to learn which smell he hates most.
Tell Kevin about the smell that Noodles disliked the most.
Finalize the contract with Hugo Chief in Venore now that all requirements are met.
The uniform deal is secured. Inform Kevin Postner.

missions.title: Measurement Duty
steps: Lokur via Kroox in Kazordoon
Chrystal in the Venore depot
You collected every required measurement. Return to Kevin Postner.
Gather the following measurements for Hugo Chief:

missions.title: Waldo's Posthorn
steps: Kevin already received Waldo's posthorn. Await your next assignment.
You found Waldo's posthorn. Bring it back to Kevin Postner immediately.
Search the caves beneath the troll-infested mountain east of Thais, find Postofficer Waldo and recover his posthorn.

missions.title: Letters to Santa
steps: Deliver the bag of letters from the post office basement to Santa's mailbox on the isle of Vega.
Santa received the letters. Return to Kevin for the final assignment.

missions.title: Mintwallin Delivery
steps: Sneak into Mintwallin and hand Markwin the letter from his mother.
Markwin accepted his mother's letter. Kevin will surely promote you for completing all postman missions.
